args.stdin: WITH customer AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_email FROM customer_accounts WHERE customer_email = 'matthias.schuster+986@icloud.com'), employee AS (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_accounts WHERE employee_id = NULL), basket AS (SELECT basket_id, record_path, basket_status, discount_percent, discount_reason_code, discount_issuer_employee_id FROM shopping_baskets WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM customer) AND basket_status = 'active' ORDER BY basket_created_at DESC LIMIT 1), subtotal AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sbi.requested_quantity * pv.price_cents), 0) AS subtotal_cents FROM shopping_basket_items sbi JOIN product_variants pv ON sbi.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE sbi.basket_id = (SELECT basket_id FROM basket)) SELECT (SELECT customer_id FROM customer) AS customer_id, (SELECT customer_email FROM customer) AS customer_email, (SELECT employee_id FROM employee) AS discount_issuer_employee_id, (SELECT basket_id FROM basket) AS basket_id, (SELECT record_path FROM basket) AS basket_record_path, (SELECT basket_status FROM basket) AS basket_status, (SELECT discount_percent FROM basket) AS existing_discount_percent, (SELECT subtotal_cents FROM subtotal) AS subtotal_cents, CASE WHEN (SELECT subtotal_cents FROM subtotal) >= 15000 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS allowed_discount_percent;

WITH basket AS (SELECT basket_id FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = '$basket_id'), allowed AS (SELECT $allowed_discount_percent AS pct) UPDATE shopping_baskets SET discount_percent = (SELECT pct FROM allowed), discount_reason_code = 'service_recovery', discount_issuer_employee_id = $discount_issuer_employee_id WHERE basket_id = (SELECT basket_id FROM basket);

denied_security.message: Cannot apply discount: employee not authorized.

unsupported.message: Cannot apply discount: basket not eligible (not found, not active, or already has discount).

ok.message: Applied {allowed_discount_percent}% service_recovery discount to basket {basket_id} for customer {customer_email}.
